newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies eight issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies eight issues for bond insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said it has qualified for bond insurance the following eight municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Limestone County Board of Education, Ala., $5 million capital outlay bonds.
--Western Kentucky University, Ky., $6.625 million revenue bonds.
--Livingston County, Mich., $4.675 million sewer disposal system bonds.
--Phoenix Central School District, N.Y., $2.99 million school general obligation bonds.
--Rensselaer CSD, N.Y., $8.05 million school district GOs.
--Longview, Texas, $8 million tax and revenue bonds.
--Greenbrier County BOE, W.Va., $8 million school bonds.
